DeterminationBasis: T09-001 establishes that the mandatory pre-execution gate may issue the applicable permit state only after all required gate predicates are evaluated, with execution remaining a separate event. T09-004 covers the complementary failure case: where any mandatory predicate is unknown or unavailable, the gate produces HOLD or NOT_ESTABLISHED and does not issue execution permission. Together these controls establish that consequential execution cannot proceed unless every required mandatory predicate is established.

T08-007 directly establishes that ALLOW permits only bounded progression within its declared governance scope and does not permit any later mandatory execution predicate to be skipped, presumed satisfied or bypassed solely because ALLOW exists. This directly covers the prohibition on an earlier ALLOW determination bypassing a later failed execution predicate.
